text.tspan: Stunting measures the share of children younger than 5 years that are too short for their age. GDP per capita is
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: World Health Organization - Global Health Observatory (2026); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year
